Name: FreeCAD Plugin
Description: Dynamic FreeCAD workbench bridge for Ulanzi D200X.
Detail:
FreeCAD Dynamic Bridge turns your Ulanzi D200X into a context-aware CAD console.

Key Features:
• Automatic Workbench Sync: Keys and icons dynamically adapt as you switch between Part Design, Sketcher, Part, and general views.
• Smart Multi-Page Navigation: Instant pagination with live dot indicators across Part Design (2 pages) and Sketcher (Sketch, Constraints, Tools).
• Context-Aware Intelligence: Automatically jumps to Constraints/Tools when selecting Sketcher geometry, and switches to an interactive Numpad whenever a numeric input dialog opens.
• Zero-Friction Setup: Includes a ready-to-use D200X profile and a 1-click Bridge installer inside the Property Inspector.

Quick Setup:
1. Select any FreeCAD Dynamic Slot key in Ulanzi Studio.
2. Click "Install / Update FreeCAD Bridge" and restart FreeCAD.
3. Open FreeCAD — your D200X profile switches and syncs automatically.

Notes:
• Works locally via 127.0.0.1 (no cloud, no telemetry).
• Supports macOS 10.15+ and Windows 10+ with FreeCAD 0.21 / 1.0+.
Author: kennykoyama
